Lincolnwood homeowners, if your fence has started to lean after this year's wet stretch, the posts are the first place to look. Push on a few sections and see if they wobble at the ground line, since that is usually where rot starts. Check for soft, dark wood right where the post meets the soil, and look along the fence line for sections that sit lower than the rest. Catching a rotted post early often means a simple repair, while waiting can turn it into a full section replacement. We can take a look and tell you which one you are dealing with.

From the owner
At Simi Valley Kitchen Bath Remodeling, we transform tired interiors into bright, hardworking spaces built with durable materials, smart layouts, and dependable general contracting standards. Our Core Remodeling Services: Expansive, Entertaining-Ready Kitchens: Custom shaker and contemporary flat-panel cabinetry, durable stain-resistant quartz countertops, oversized prep and breakfast islands, walk-in pantry conversions, and recessed LED task lighting. Spa-Inspired Bath Retreats: Frameless glass walk-in showers with built-in niches, freestanding deep-soaking bathtubs, dual-sink floating or furniture-style vanities, and precision-set porcelain tile work. Open-Concept Structural Reconfigurations: Removing non-load-bearing dividing walls to connect kitchens seamlessly with family living zones, improving circulation and drawing in natural light. The Simi Valley Quality Commitment: Transparent, itemized estimates with zero hidden surprises, strict milestone tracking, full City of Simi Valley permitting support, and clean, dust-controlled job sites from demo day through final sign-off. Solid construction, functional layouts, and enduring finishes tailored to the Simi Valley lifestyle.
